name: appeal-the-denial
description: Appeal the Denial reads a health insurance denial letter, explanation of benefits or adverse benefit determination that the person pastes in, and returns what was denied and the reason the insurer gave; which appeal rules apply (employer plan under ERISA, ACA Marketplace, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, Original Medicare, FEHB); the appeal deadline, computed in code from the federal regulation and cited to it; who decides next if the appeal fails; and a draft appeal letter. It never judges whether care was medically necessary and gives no medical advice: the clinical case comes from the person's own doctor, and the draft asks for that letter. Both tools are read-only. The letter is used only for the request and nothing is stored. No account is needed.

defaultPrompt: My insurer denied my MRI. Here's the letter: when is my appeal due?
My Medicare Advantage plan denied a claim in a letter dated October 30, 2026. When's my appeal due?
My employer plan denied my final appeal on October 30, 2026. What now?

positive.description: Read an employer-plan (ERISA) denial letter and return the appeal deadline and a draft letter.
positive.prompt:
Northstar Health Insurance Company
PO Box 4410, Minneapolis, MN 55440

Date of this notice: October 14, 2026

Jordan Rivera
1820 Elm Street
St. Paul, MN 55104

NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Member: Jordan Rivera
Member ID: NSH448812907
Group number: 70122
Claim number: 26-0918-55412
Provider: Lakeside Imaging Center
Date of service: 09/18/2026
Service: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148)
Amount billed: $2,140.00
Amount denied: $2,140.00

We have denied payment for this claim.

Reason for denial: The service is not medically necessary. Based on our clinical policy for advanced imaging of the spine, the records do not show six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. Code CO-50.

Your plan is a group health plan sponsored by your employer and is governed by the Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA). Northstar is the claims administrator for your employer's self-funded plan.

You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of receiving this notice. You may request, free of charge, copies of all documents relevant to your claim. After the internal appeal you may have the right to an external review and to bring a civil action under Section 502(a) of ERISA.

Send your appeal to: Northstar Appeals, PO Box 4412, Minneapolis, MN 55440. Fax 1-800-555-0144.

What's my deadline and what do I send?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies an ERISA employer plan; internal appeal due Mon, April 12, 2027, cited to 29 CFR 2560.503-1(h)(3)(i); returns a draft appeal letter that asks for the treating doctor's letter.

positive.description: Read a Medicare Advantage denial and return the reconsideration deadline.
positive.prompt:
Evergreen Medicare Advantage (HMO)
NOTICE OF DENIAL OF MEDICAL COVERAGE

Date: 10/22/2026
Member name: Dolores Whitfield
Member ID: EV-55120934
Request number: AUTH-7731902

We have denied the request for coverage for: 12 additional outpatient physical therapy visits.
Requesting provider: Dr. Samuel Ortiz, Ortiz Orthopedics

Why we denied your request: The information provided does not meet our clinical criteria for continued therapy. Your progress notes show you have reached a plateau.

You have the right to ask Evergreen Medicare Advantage to review our decision by asking us for an appeal (a reconsideration). You must ask within 60 calendar days of the date of this notice. If you or your doctor believe waiting 30 days could seriously harm your health, ask for a fast (expedited) appeal.

Help me appeal this.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Medicare Advantage; reconsideration due Mon, December 21, 2026; notes the plan must forward an upheld denial to the Independent Review Entity.

positive.description: Read a Medicaid managed-care drug denial.
positive.prompt:
River Valley Health Plan
A Medicaid managed care plan for Medical Assistance members

Notice date: November 2, 2026

Member: Andre Thompson
Medicaid ID: 00384719
Reference: RX-2210457

We cannot approve the request for the drug Humira (adalimumab) 40 mg.
Reason: This medication requires prior authorization and step therapy. Our records do not show that a preferred drug was tried first.

You can appeal this decision with us. You have 60 days from the date of this notice to ask for an appeal. If we deny your appeal, you can ask for a state fair hearing.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies Medicaid managed care; appeal due Fri, January 1, 2027, cited to 42 CFR 438.402(c)(2)(ii).

positive.description: Compute a deadline from a plan type and letter date without a letter.
positive.prompt: My Medicare Advantage plan denied a claim in a letter dated October 30, 2026. When's my appeal due?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Sun, January 3, 2027 (five days presumed receipt plus 60 days), cited to 42 CFR 422.582.

positive.description: Return the external review deadline after a final internal denial on an employer plan.
positive.prompt: My employer plan denied my final appeal on October 30, 2026. What now?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an external review request due Mon, March 1, 2027, cited to 29 CFR 2590.715-2719(d)(2)(i).

negative.description: Do not judge medical necessity; the app gives no medical advice.
Do not trigger for general health questions unrelated to an insurance denial.
negative.prompt: What are the side effects of ibuprofen?

negative.description: Do not trigger for a request to contact the insurer; the app sends nothing.
negative.prompt: Call my insurance company and file the appeal for me.

review.commerce_description: No purchase or payment happens in ChatGPT. The tools return only the deadline, the appeal path and a draft letter.
